title: U.S. 2-year Treasury yield rises as oil tops $100 a barrel
summary_full: The yield on the U.S. 2-year Treasury note added 2 basis points early Wednesday, as oil hovered above the $100 mark.
summary_public: The yield on the U.S. 2-year Treasury note added 2 basis points early Wednesday, as oil hovered above the $100 mark.
